name: Umbral Alba
motion: Tilt-and-turn: the handle turns up and the leaf tips in 7° from the top (Sash_Tilt), or turns level and the leaf swings in 85° on concealed hinges (Sash_Turn); two-leaf versions move both leaves, mirrored.
options: Size and leaves (6 variants: one or two leaves × 3 sizes)
Interior · wood: Roble Ahumado, Nogal, Piedra, Negro Carbón
Exterior · aluminium: Acero Grafito, Bronce Umbra, Negro Carbón, Piedra, Anodizado Natural
Handle: Bronce Umbra, Latón Cepillado, Anodizado Natural, Acero Grafito, Negro Carbón
Glass: Claro double 5/27/5 argon, Claro triple, Bronce tinted, Satinado acid-etched

hotspots.title: Tilt for air
hotspots.text: Turn the handle up and the leaf tips in 7° from the top. Air moves, rain stays out.

hotspots.title: Turn to open
hotspots.text: Handle level, the leaf swings in 85° on its hidden hinges. The whole opening is clear.

hotspots.title: Welded corners
hotspots.text: Frame and leaf are each one welded ring, 7 mm radius at the corners. No mitre line to open up.

hotspots.title: Hinges inside the frame
hotspots.text: The pivots sit in the rebate. Closed, nothing shows.

hotspots.title: Solid wood inside
hotspots.text: 28.7 mm of timber on the frame, 16 mm on the leaf, facing the room. Smoked oak, walnut or painted.

hotspots.title: Insulating glass
hotspots.text: 5 mm, 27 mm argon, 5 mm, held in a 45 mm rabbet. Triple glazing on request.

hotspots.title: Aluminium outside
hotspots.text: A thermally broken aluminium shell takes the weather. The whole section is 121 mm deep.

geometry.note: sightline = interior frame 13 + leaf 62 (+ gaps) read from the source section; leaf = 1500 × 1800 frame less 13 mm wood frame and 2 mm gap each side

stills.finish: Acero Grafito outside, Roble Ahumado inside, Bronce Umbra handle

gaps: Sizes are estimated (made to measure; no published sizes in the source).
Hotspot pins show on the default variant only (platform behaviour inherited from the source build); the animations still play in every variant via the default view.
Handle finishes share one metallic roughness map, so Negro Carbón and Piedra handles read slightly metallic.
No inward fly screen modelled (it would block the tilt/turn).
Hero still shows the leaf only slightly open: the 85° turn hides the frame shadow on the floor.
